description: This Java source file defines the ModelIndex class, which models the <index> element in an entity framework, including methods for creation, XML serialization, and internal data management.

classes.name: ModelIndex
classes.description: Represents an index in an entity model, including properties like name, uniqueness, and fields, with methods for XML serialization.

classes.name: ModelIndex.Field
classes.description: Represents a field within a ModelIndex, including field name and optional function (LOWER, UPPER).

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ModelIndex instance with specified properties or from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the index.

methods.name: getUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether the index enforces uniqueness.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields included in the index.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the ModelIndex to an XML element.
